lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 对不起，请问火车站怎么走？
lines.english: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 火车站在前面。直走，然后左转。
lines.pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn zài qiánmiàn. Zhí zǒu, ránhòu zuǒ zhuǎn.
lines.english: The train station is ahead. Go straight, then turn left.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Yuǎn bu yuǎn? Zǒulù yào jǐ fēnzhōng?
lines.english: Is it far? How many minutes to walk?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Bù yuǎn. Zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
lines.english: Not far. Ten minutes walk and you're there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thanks. Then where is the hospital?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 医院在火车站右边。很近。
lines.pinyin: Yīyuàn zài huǒchēzhàn yòubian. Hěn jìn.
lines.english: The hospital is to the right of the train station. Very close.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ míngbai le. Zàijiàn!
